findings.detail: Multiple migration heads detected: ['0025_harden_access_table_rls', '0037_add_webhook_tables']. Repo is in inconsistent state -- run `alembic heads` locally and merge.

findings.detail: No idempotency key handling detected. Re-runs of the same evaluation will produce duplicate compliance_score rows.
findings.suggested_fix: Use `target_company_id + rule_engine_version + snapshot_hash` as a unique key; skip if a row already exists for this combination.

findings.detail: Score writes appear not to be wrapped in a DB transaction. Partial failures leave stale scores + missing audit records.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap every compliance_score INSERT/UPDATE in `async with db.begin():` so partial failures roll back atomically.

findings.detail: No visible evaluation_status field. Cannot detect partial evaluations from the data alone.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an `evaluation_status` enum column: PENDING / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / FAILED. Set to IN_PROGRESS at start; COMPLETED only after audit row is committed.
